description: Champion minimal: only empirically-validated layers from KEY_FINDINGS.md / TODO.md. Drops state_eval_phase_weights (0% WR in L6), adaptive_exploration_enabled (8% WR in L9), opponent_modeling/alliance/kingmaker (no benefit + 2.4x slower in L7), sufficiency_threshold/loss_avoidance (inconclusive in L9). Adds num_workers=2 + parallel_strategy=root (46% WR + TrueSkill #1 in L8 strength run, never deployed in champion_v1). Same total iteration budget as champion_v1 (250 iter at 500ms x 0.5 iter/ms) for an apples-to-apples comparison.
